title: bridge test: the trust-dialog dismissal check matches the cd and launch sends, so it can never fail
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 46 (bridge group 2, 2026-09-26). driver_claudetmux_test.go looks for a send ending in `|true` before the paste. The cd and launch sends also end in `|true`, so dismissedBeforePaste is always true, and only the pasteContext check guards the dialog. Also: driver_claudetmux.go hardcodes tmuxPromptMarkerDefault while manifests/claude-tmux.json defines prompt_marker (read by recipe_adapter.go); the headless codex driver has no ChatGPT model clamp, unlike codex-tmux (noted in internal-llmroute.md).
fix: Match the bare dismissal send exactly (`sent == "|true"`, or the auto-responder's recorded key), and mutation-check that removing the dismissal fails the test. Read the prompt marker from the manifest.
acceptance: removing the auto-responder's trust-dialog rule fails the dismissal assertion (mutation check)
